mapper.select:
/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSharedSessionList */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , S.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt /* 나를 지정한 회사명(개설사 아님 — 인접 차수 가시성) */ , IFNULL(DC.CMPNY_NM, '') AS designatedByCmpnyNm , DATE_FORMAT(SH.DESIGNATED_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS designatedDtime /* 내 회사 참석자 수(입실 기준). 타사 참석자 수는 노출하지 않는다. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND AT.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) AS myAttendanceCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE SH ON ( SH.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND SH.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY DC ON ( DC.CMPNY_CD = SH.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( S.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY SH.DESIGNATED_DTIME DESC, S.SESSION_CD DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionList */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* 연계 위험성평가 수 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* 출결 집계. DEL_YN='N' 기준. [정합성 수정] 앱과 동일 정의 — 참석=실입실(ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL). */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount /* 미이수 = 실입실 + 미완료(상태 NULL=미완료 또는 NOT_COMPLETED). 자동이수 폐지로 NULL 포함. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 상태 우선순위(IN_PROGRESS > OPENED > DRAFT > COMPLETED > CANCELLED) -> 개설일/등록일 desc */ ORDER BY CASE A.STATUS_CD WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'OPENED' THEN 2 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 3 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 4 WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END , A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionDetail */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , A.CONTENT_FORMAT_CD AS contentFormatCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , A.EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , A.MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , A.MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes , A.GPS_MANUAL_CONFIRM_YN AS gpsManualConfirmYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt /* 교육준비 타이머 기준시각(15분 자동 교육시작 기준). FE 카운트다운용. 초 단위까지 노출 */ , DATE_FORMAT(A.PREP_START_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS prepStartAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CANCELLED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cancelledAt , A.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionGuard */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd /* 교육준비(prepare) DB값 기준 검증용: 제목/교육내용/교육시간 */ , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , M.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 항목의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다. */ WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc /* 6.2-(1)-2: 교육자료 스코프(사업장/공통) 표시 */ , M.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN M.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = M.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT SR.SITE_CD AS siteCd , SR.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RA.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , RA.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , SR.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder /* 6.2-(1)-2: 평가요청일/평가요청자(콘솔 요약 표시) */ , RA.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , DATE_FORMAT(RA.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS initAssessDate , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', RA.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS initAssessorNm /* 결정#5: 읽기전용 상세 팝업(RiskAssessInfo) 채움용 평가 상세(Risk03 selectRiskAssessmentsLists 규약 재사용) */ , RA.INIT_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS initLikelihoodScore , RA.INIT_SEVERITY_SCORE AS initSeverityScore , RA.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , RA.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , RA.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID AS initAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', RA.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', RA.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFilePath , RA.REVAL_DATE AS revalDate , RA.REVAL_BEFORE_DESC AS revalBeforeDesc , RA.REVAL_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS revalLikelihoodScore , RA.REVAL_SEVERITY_SCORE AS revalSeverityScore , RA.REVAL_RISK_LV AS revalRiskLv , RA.REVAL_DESC AS revalDesc , RA.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID AS revalAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', RA.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS revalAssessorNm , RA.REVAL_ASSESS_DATE AS revalAssessDate , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', RA.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS revalFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(RA.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', RA.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS revalFilePath FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER
mapper.update: /* Tbm02Mapper.upsertSessionState */ INSERT INTO TB_TBM_SESSION_STATE ( CMPNY_CD , SESSION_CD , CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{sessionCd} , 0 , 'PAUSED' , #{gvUserCd} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX = NEW.CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD = NEW.SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY = NEW.LAST_UPDATED_BY , UPDATE_NO = NEW.INSERT_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
mapper.select: /* Tbm02Mapper.selectExpiredPrepForStart */ SELECT CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , SITE_CD AS siteCd , MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION WHERE STATUS_CD = 'OPENED' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND PREP_START_AT IS NOT NULL AND PREP_START_AT <= (NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
mapper.update: /* Tbm02Mapper.bulkStartExpiredPrep */ UPDATE TB_TBM_SESSION SET STATUS_CD = 'IN_PROGRESS' , STARTED_AT = NOW() , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE STATUS_CD = 'OPENED' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND PREP_START_AT IS NOT NULL AND PREP_START_AT <= (NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
mapper.select: /* Tbm02Mapper.selectSiteOptions */ SELECT A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SITE_NM AS siteNm FROM TB_SITE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SITE_NM
mapper.update: /* Tbm02Mapper.restoreManagerEntry */ UPDATE TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE SET DEL_YN = 'N' , ENTRY_TYPE_CD = 'MANAGER_DIRECT' , ENTRY_BY_MANAGER_USER_CD = #{managerUserCd} , ENTRY_AT = NOW() , ENTRY_GPS_LAT = NULL , ENTRY_GPS_LON = NULL , ENTRY_DISTANCE_M = NULL , APP_FOREGROUND_SEC = NULL , EXIT_TYPE_CD = NULL , EXIT_BY_MANAGER_USER_CD = NULL , EXIT_AT = NULL , EXIT_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD = NULL , EXIT_FORCED_REASON = NULL , COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = NULL , NOT_COMPLETED_REASON = NULL , STATUS_UPDATED_BY = NULL , STATUS_UPDATED_AT = NULL , UPDATE_NO = #{managerUserCd} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{targetCmpnyCd} AND SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} AND DEL_YN = 'Y'
